hits.title: Bonusly launches Bizy, an AI agent that helps teams connect and grow together again
hits.snippet: Bonusly launches Bizy, an AI agent that helps teams connect and grow together again Accessibility Statement Skip Navigation ... BOULDER, Colo., Aug. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bonusly, the recognition and rewards platform used by more than 3,400 companies, today announced the launch of Bizy, an AI agent that finds the recognition moments teams miss and brings them back into view, so employees can connect with each other, recognize wins, and participate actively in company culture. ... Bizy is available now to Bonusly customers as part of the platform's recognition and rewards suite. Learn more at bonusly.com/features/meet-bizy.

# The story of Bonusly, Bizy, and where we're heading next
...
That's the idea Bonusly was built on. Recognition, real and specific, given often enough, is how a team connects and does incredible work, together.
...
## Meet Bizy
...
Bizy is Bonusly's recognition sidekick, and its whole job is to make sure good work doesn't slip by unnoticed. It notices the moments worth celebrating, helps people give better recognition more often, and keeps managers and people leaders a step ahead of employee engagement.Bizy lives inside Bonusly and beyond, helping you stay a little closer to all the great stuff your team is up to. It connects to the tools your team uses to get work done, like Slack, Teams, Granola, Linear, and Bonusly itself. It then adapts to a person’s unique role and remembers useful context over time. That means it can notice great work happening across multiple work spaces, learn how employees like to connect and collaborate, and help everyone know who to recognize, and when, and why.
...
Bonusly has always been about building that kind of culture. Bizy is the next chapter of that mission, giving teams a fun, new way to feel connected, engaged, and valued.

# Meet Bizy: Your new recognition sidekick
...
Bizy is Bonusly's recognition sidekick. It's an AI agent that helps everyone on a team show up better for each other, every day. It notices the moments worth celebrating, helps people give better recognition more often, and keeps managers and people leaders a step ahead of engagement.
...
With live access to recognition, 1:1 history, check-in trends, goals, and org structure (within the same permissions you already have), Bizy helps everyone on the team connect more and collaborate better. ...

It notices the moments worth celebrating, helps people give better recognition more often, and keeps managers and people leaders a step ahead of engagement trends. When your company connects tools like Slack, Microsoft Teams, GitHub, Linear, or Granola, Bizy can see a fuller picture of how your team works together, not just what gets posted in Bonusly.
